title: SceneDM: Scene-level Multi-agent Trajectory Generation with Consistent Diffusion Models

control_signal.value: No user-steerable signal; generation is conditioned on road network and agents' historical trajectories only. Text-conditioned generation is listed as future work.

control_mechanism.value: Scene-encoder agent embeddings condition a Transformer denoiser. Temporal-consistent guidance averages overlapping noise predictions for smoothness, and a scoring module filters collisions and off-road samples; neither is user control.

base_model.value: DDPM-style diffusion with a scene-centric vectorized scene encoder and Transformer denoiser alternating self-attention across time and across agents; generates velocities integrated into trajectories.

datasets.value: Waymo Open Motion Dataset (486,995 train, 44,097 val, 44,920 test scenarios); Waymo Sim Agents Benchmark; ablations on 1,000 random validation scenarios.

metrics.value: Waymo Sim Agents realism meta-metric with kinematic, interactive (collision, time to collision) and map-based (offroad) components, based on approximate negative log-likelihood.

controllability_evidence.value: not stated in packet; no controllability experiment shown. Realism meta-metric reaches 0.5060 for SceneDMF and 0.5000 for SceneDM on the benchmark.

notes: Not a controllable-generation paper: it is a realistic multi-agent simulation model. Only future-work mention of conditional generation from text descriptions.
